name: Messages Improved
summary: Group MMS fixes, a faster inbox and iMessage
description: Improves the stock Messages app and its providers. Group MMS goes to the right thread, and conversations open faster. Optional iMessage through your own imsg-server: pair with a code under Settings > Advanced settings and the phone registers its number, with SMS fallback.
author: thooton

changes.text: Background row pre-inflation pool (WaveRowPool) and cached isSmsEnabled.
Harvest early history query before first frame, cached WaveTimeFormat, reuse inbox group avatars.
Eliminate redundant SMS Linkify/zoom prefs, start history query in initialize, async phone snapshot & inbox row reuse.
Fast-path group iMessages & carrier text MMS, launch history query in onStart, offload startup I/O.
Fix duplicated MMS snippet lines in conversation list.
Fix text sizing, image anti-aliasing, media margins, and chat-open performance.
Open single videos directly in full-screen player (1.8.4).
Match full-screen video player HUD to Sonim MovieView (1.8.3).
Add elapsed and total duration timestamps to full-screen video player (1.8.2).
Disable video auto-play and play videos full-screen in AttachmentViewActivity (1.8.1).
